modules.title: Functions of Real Variables
modules.content:
What is a Function?

A function f from set X (Domain) to set Y (Codomain) assigns exactly one element f(x) to every x in X.

modules.title: Limits & Limit Theorems
modules.content:
Why Limits?

Before calculus, we could calculate the slope of a straight line. But how do you find the slope of a curve at one exact point? The answer: bring two points closer and closer together and see what the slope approaches.
